title: MatchDetail
description: Canonical reconstructed match. Events are valid CanonicalEvent only (quarantine excluded). Build/runtime: tsMin == min(events.ts), tsMax == max(events.ts), tsMin <= tsMax; humanCount/botCount are distinct actor counts, not event counts.

humanCount.description: Count of distinct canonical human actors (userId) in this match, not the number of human events.

botCount.description: Count of distinct canonical bot actors (userId) in this match, not the number of bot events.

tsMin.description: Minimum ts among valid canonical events; MUST be <= tsMax. Build/runtime: tsMin == min(events.ts).

tsMax.description: Maximum ts among valid canonical events; MUST be >= tsMin. Build/runtime: tsMax == max(events.ts).

tsUnit.description: Physical unit recorded after schema inspection (this export: ms). Not calendar time.

events.description: Flattened journeys, sorted by ts ascending. Quarantine records MUST NOT appear.
